chunks: It was brought to Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, and it was said to him: A predatory bird is on the Ka‘bah; nothing from the pigeons of the Haram passes by it except that it strikes it. So he said: “Set up for it and kill it, for it has indeed committed ilḥād.”

key_terms.أَلْحَدَ: it committed desecration or violated the sanctity of the sacred precinct
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Ka‘bah, the sacred House in Makkah
key_terms.اِنْصِبُوا: set up for it; lie in wait or take position against it
key_terms.حَمَامِ الْحَرَمِ: the pigeons of the sacred sanctuary

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a predatory bird attacking the pigeons of the Haram near the Ka‘bah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal instruction from Imam Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام regarding a predatory bird harming the pigeons of the Haram while stationed on the Ka‘bah. The Imam عليه السلام orders that it be targeted and killed, describing its act as ilḥād, indicating a violation of the sanctity of the sacred precinct.
